authorization_change: WHO GAINS UPLOAD AND OWNED-INPUT ANALYSIS: a non-Opal viewer whose verified edge token names firm F (x-firm-id) and whose class, re-derived from the same verified headers, is FIRM_ADVISOR or FIRM_OPERATIONS, and only for firm F. The conditions are the four of the CTO ruling, all required: (1) the firm and the subject come from the verified headers, never a body or query; (2) the firm equals the principal's firm, the retained owner's firm and the data firm; (3) the subject's canonical users PROFILE row has the exact status 'active' and an explicit allowedFirmIds list that names F (not ALL, no non-string member, not empty); (4) the subject has a partner row in opal-partner-F keyed by the same email. The Lambda's role can read those partner rows only for its three enabled client firms (49financial, inflection, cottonwood, Terraform source generate.tf:206-211 and :242-246), so at this vintage the viewers who gain either route are the advisors and firm-operations users of those three firms, each for its own firm only. BOTH ROUTES: the upload door (compose_upload, generate_installed.py :389-426) and the owned-input analysis route (ProspectSubmissionFactory.submit, prospect_submission.py :64-65) consult the same callable, and for the owned-input route the retained owner's principal_id and firm must equal the viewer's (interactive_access.py :117), so a viewer gains only its OWN firm's input, and another advisor's input in the same firm stays refused. OPEN REACH (surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W121-S2, BLOCKING): the same authorize_current is also the authorizer of the retained repositories built inside both routes (generate_installed.py :312-313 and :426) and of the upload service that reads the retained input (prospect_submission.py :68), so an admitted viewer passes the producer for those retained paths too; this is not in the ruling and the CTO must rule before a release pair ships. STILL REFUSED NOT_AUTHORIZED before any file is read: a viewer of another firm (the producer fails at the firm equality and the owner equality); a token with no verified firm; a firm named only in a body or query (never consulted); an inactive, disabled or unknown-status user; a profile without the firm, with ALL, or with a non-string member; a subject with no partner row for the firm; a profile or partner row for another email; a reader that raises or returns nothing; CLIENT, RENDER_DELEGATE and UNKNOWN classes. OPAL IS UNCHANGED ON BOTH ROUTES: an OPAL_GLOBAL principal is authorised by InteractiveAccess.authorize_current before the producer is consulted (interactive_access.py :115-116), the producer refuses an Opal principal (ordinary_viewer.py :64-65), and tests show the producer is never called for Opal on either route (spy and absent). Built only: nothing is released, deployed, pushed, uploaded or applied, and the never-widen pair that would ship it is the issuer's.
